samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
	<description>Implements pulse detection logic for a single-bit input signal data_in.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
		
		<input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
		
		<output id="data_out">Output signal indicating detected pulses.</output>
	endports
	
	<implementation>Implements pulse detection logic for a single-bit input signal data_in. It resets the state to 0 when rst_n is asserted and checks for transitions between values 0 and 1 to detect pulses. The data_out signal indicates the end of a pulse when transitioning from 0 to 1 and then back to 0.</implementation>
	
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		<reg id="state">The current state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
		<assign>next_state = state + 1;</assign>
		<always id="seq_block" event_control="posedge clk or negedge rst_n">
			if(~rst_n) begin
				state <= 0;
			end else begin
				case(state)
					0 : begin
						if(data_in == 1) begin
							state <= 1;
						end else begin
							state <= 0;
						end
					end
					
					1 : begin
						if(data_in == 1) begin
							state <= 2;
						end else begin
							state <= 0;
						end
					end
					
					2 : begin
						if(data_in == 1) begin
							state <= 3;
						end else begin
							state <= 0;
						end
					end
					
					default : begin
						state <= 0;
					end
				endcase
			end
		end
		
		<always id="comb_block" event_control="*">
			case(state)
				0 : data_out = 0;
				
				1 : data_out = 0;
				
				2 : data_out = 0;
				
				3 : data_out = 1;
				
				default : data_out = 0;
			endcase
		end
		
	endlogic_description
	
</module>
